passage.text: Nam and Emma are shopping at the mall.
passage.reading: ˈnɑːm ənd ˈɛmə ər ˈʃɑːpɪŋ ət ðə ˈmɔːl.

passage.text: Nam likes a green jacket, so she takes it to the fitting room.
passage.reading: ˈnɑːm ˈlaɪks ə ˈɡriːn ˈdʒækɪt, soʊ ʃiː ˈteɪks ɪt tə ðə ˈfɪtɪŋ ˌruːm.

passage.text: "It doesn't fit. It's too big," Nam says.
passage.reading: ɪt ˈdʌzənt ˈfɪt. ɪts ˈtuː ˈbɪɡ, ˈnɑːm ˈsɛz.

passage.text: "Excuse me, do you have a smaller size?" she says to the woman at the shop.
passage.reading: ɪkˈskjuːz miː, duː juː ˈhæv ə ˈsmɔːlər ˈsaɪz? ʃiː ˈsɛz tə ðə ˈwʊmən ət ðə ˈʃɑːp.

passage.text: "Yes, here's a small," the woman says.
passage.reading: ˈjɛs, hɪrz ə ˈsmɔːl, ðə ˈwʊmən ˈsɛz.

passage.text: Nam tries on the small jacket, and it fits perfectly.
passage.reading: ˈnɑːm ˈtraɪz ˈɑːn ðə ˈsmɔːl ˈdʒækɪt, ənd ɪt ˈfɪts ˈpɜːrfɪktli.

passage.text: Emma says, "It suits you, Nam! Green is your color."
passage.reading: ˈɛmə ˈsɛz, ɪt ˈsuːts juː, ˈnɑːm! ˈɡriːn ɪz jʊr ˈkʌlər.

passage.text: Nam is very happy, and she buys the jacket.
passage.reading: ˈnɑːm ɪz ˈvɛri ˈhæpi, ənd ʃiː ˈbaɪz ðə ˈdʒækɪt.
